description: Land Acquisition - Wilpita, Athuraliya D/S Division, Matara District  - Gaz. Ex. No. 687/10 of 06.11.1991 - Amend Aturaliya D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (Lots 669, 700, 701) with descriptions of the properties, their locations, extents, and claimants. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters including acquisition procedures, compensation claims, and legal notifications related to land rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
